source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cookie management (PDF 181).

blocks.text: Cookies chhoti files hain jo websites aap ke computer par store karti hain. Cookie management (cookies ko sambhalna) ka matlab hai yeh faisla karna ke kaunsi cookies rakhni hain aur kaunsi delete karni hain.
Misal: Aap apni pasandeeda shopping website ki cookies rakh sakte hain ta ke har dafa login na karna pare, lekin doosri sites ki cookies delete kar dein ta ke aap ki privacy mehfooz rahe.

blocks.prompt: Cookies kahan se manage ki ja sakti hain?
blocks.explanation: Browser ki settings (privacy ya cookies wale hisse) se, jahan cookies dekhi aur delete ki ja sakti hain, aur website ke cookie banner par jahan aap chun sakte hain ke kaunsi cookies allow karni hain.

items: Cookie management: faidemand cookies rakhein (pasandeeda site), baqi delete karein (privacy).
